title: Red flags you might be ignoring in yourself

slides.title: Red flags you might be ignoring *in yourself*
Keeping *score* in your head
slides.body: Try instead: let the small stuff go.

slides.title: Going *quiet* instead of talking
slides.body: Try instead: “I’m upset, can we talk later?”

slides.title: Checking *their phone*
slides.body: Try instead: talk about what’s worrying you.

slides.title: Jokes at *their expense*
slides.body: Try instead: tease only what they laugh at too.

slides.title: Never apologizing *first*
slides.body: Try instead: go first. It’s not losing.

slides.title: Bringing up *old fights*
slides.body: Try instead: settle it once, then let it rest.

slides.title: Save this *and be honest with yourself.*
slides.sub: Which one hit a little too close?
